front.title: Acceptance of DNSSEC Parameters in EPP

abstract.t: The Extensible Provisioning Protocol (EPP) is used to submit DNSSEC parameters for domain names to domain name registries. Registries and registrars often restrict the values they accept, and those restrictions vary from registry to registry. The resulting uncertainty makes it difficult for DNS operators to adopt new algorithms. This document recommends that registries and registrars base their acceptance policies on the IANA registries for DNSSEC algorithms and digest types.
